etermine the number of male contestants:**

    $$ \text{Number of males} = \text{Total contestants} - \text{Number of females} $$
    $$ \text{Number of males} = 18 - 6 $$
    $$ \text{Number of males} = 12 $$

    $$ \text{Number of males} = 18 - \left(\frac{1}{3} \times 18\right) = 18 - 6 = 12 $$

    Therefore, there are 12 male contestants.

\boxed{12}
